name: Demo Flight
location_str: ADD Offshore launch platform @ Sea Launch, ???
destination_explanation: A satellite this low sweeps across the sky in a few minutes, so a ground station only gets a short window to talk to it on each pass.
slot_a_text: The T-0 is unconfirmed. It has already slipped twelve times. It last moved 6 days ago. There is a 4-hour window to work with.
slot_b_text: Launch pad water deluge systems reduce the intense acoustic and pressure waves produced at liftoff, protecting the rocket and launch pad.

description: Note: Launch vehicle name is provisional. First orbital full version launch of the South Korean military small satellite launch vehicle, after 2 sub-orbital tests of individual stages on 30 March and 30 December 2022, and 1 orbital test flight without the 2nd stage on 4 December 2023. Details TBD.
